name: Changeling (Legendary Games)
body:
In addition to the typical changeling character options, some changelings draw their ancestry from hags like the borda and masca.

Borda Changelings (Foscone)

A foscona is typically high, imposing, and moody. These changelings tend to be skillful and resourceful, but don’t make friend easily.

Typical Alignment: NE

Ability Score Modifiers +2 Str, +2 Wis, -2 Cha
Hag Racial Trait Foscone are proficient with the lasso, net, and rope gauntlet.
Awakened Hag Heritage

You gain the mistsight universal monster ability.

Mistsight (Ex)

The foscone can see through fog, mist, and murky water as if they were perfectly clear, ignoring the miss chance for these obstructions, up to its normal range of vision.

Borda Parents

Bordas are predatory, like their sea hag cousins, haunting the marshy areas next to rivers. She appears in dark hours and foggy days, kidnapping unwary passengers and children that she ties with her ropes and drags to her den to eat. Mothers use the borda to scare their children into behaving well. Some bordas may infiltrate villages to find themselves near a ready source of prey, and though they rarely stay long they may get with child while in disguise and return to the swamps to birth their changeling progeny.

Masca Changelings (Màgare)

A màgara has a keen intellect and an innate understanding for occult and weird events, but she is otherwise largely similar to a normal human. These changelings grow with their real mothers in a normal family and most of them lead perfectly ordinary lives, unless chosen to inherit a book of command. Though rare, male màgare do exist.

Typical Alignment CN

Ability Score Modifiers +2 Int, +2 Wis, –2 Con
Hag Racial Trait Masca-born changelings gain a +1 racial bonus on their caster level for divination spells.
Awakened Hag Heritage You can use the change shape ability once per night to assume the form of one Tiny or Small animal of your choice (once made, the choice is set). At midnight, màgare don’t have the chance to radiate an evil aura but rather a magic aura (divination and transmutation).
Masca Parents

Masche (the plural of masca) are uncharacteristic not-evil hags who live in villages along humans or in isolated shacks in the country. Though capricious and vengeful, they don’t harbor any special desire to harm people. A masca could act as a hamlet’s wise woman, curing diseases and giving advice; indistinguishable from a common woman by day, she will leave her home at night to andare in masca (assume her true identity) and fare la fisica (practice magic), taking other forms and sending her soul to fly very far from her physical body.

They become so integrated into communities that even if their true identity is discovered they might be known as “village hags” and welcomed to stay, but they prefer privacy and anonymity instead.
